context: A mom and son plan a winter family trip
purpose: Teach: ぢ/四つ/十一月/建てる/身内/本名/瀬/山中

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、十一月、おじいちゃんちに泊まるんでしょ?
lines.en: Mom, in November we're staying at Grandpa's, aren't we?
lines.style: Bright, curious lift on the opening question. Eager to confirm, seeking approval. Soft and genuine — not demanding, just hoping.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。山中の別荘、新しく建てる相談もあるみたい。
lines.en: Yes. Sounds like they're thinking about building a new place up in the mountains.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact clarity. Slight nodding rhythm. A mother sharing information naturally, inviting him into the family news without overwhelming him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 四つ、いとこが集まるって。本名で覚えなきゃ。
lines.en: Four cousins are coming. I need to learn their real names.
lines.style: Quiet determination with undertones of nervousness. Processing out loud. Small pause before the second sentence — genuine concern about getting things right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 身内ばかりで、にぎやかね。
lines.en: All your relatives together — it'll be noisy.
lines.style: Affectionate observation, gentle smile in the voice. Peaceful acceptance of the chaos to come. Slight warm trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 川の瀬で、石投げ遊びしたい。
lines.en: I want to skip stones in the river shallows.
lines.style: Quiet daydreaming quality. Gentle, specific longing. The detail of 'river shallows' spoken with small wonder — he can see it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんは、ぢが悪化したから、無理しないでって伝えてね。
lines.en: Tell Dad not to push himself — his condition's acting up again.
lines.style: Soft, practical concern. Not dramatic. The tone of someone managing family logistics with quiet care. Understated and matter-of-fact.
